data.one_liner: Keyboard shortcuts widget with help overlay and markdown support
data.what_it_does: It lets developers add keyboard shortcuts to any widget tree and provides a help screen overlay that lists the shortcuts. The overlay supports rich text via Markdown and adapts to the app theme.
use_when: You need global keyboard shortcuts in a Flutter app
You want a built‑in help screen for shortcuts
You need support for mobile keyboards or web
avoid_when: You need a stable, production‑ready package
You require advanced keybinding features like modifiers combinations beyond basic control/alt
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single widget
Markdown support for rich help text
weaknesses: Limited documentation on advanced use cases
No support for complex key combinations yet
